svg.title: Food scientist — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as food scientist, wearing a protective coat and a hair covering. Visible work cue: A rounded food sample sits on a shallow laboratory dish while a separate probe approaches its surface. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hair covering.
